title: Styled list markers
summary: Colour the numbers with ::marker, change bullets with list-style-type, and indent with padding.
explanation: Each li draws a marker: a number in an ol, a bullet in a ul. ::marker selects just that marker, so the numbers can be orange and bold while the text stays plain. Only a few properties work on ::marker (colour, font, content).

list-style-type swaps the marker: decimal, lower-alpha, upper-roman, square, or a string such as "✓ ". The marker hangs in the list's left padding, so padding-left sets how far the text is indented. Setting it to 0 pushes the markers outside the box.
Spacing between items is a margin on li, or gap if you turn the list into a grid.
tryThis: Change the ol's list-style-type to upper-roman, then to lower-alpha.
Set the ul's padding-left to 0: the ticks move out of the box.
